name: [TrendAI] - CRM Data Enrichment (Sheets in, ICP-scored out)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json._gemini_prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, maxOutputTokens: 2048, responseMimeType: 'application/json', thinkingConfig: { thinkingBudget: 0 } } }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT json_agg(t) AS icps FROM (SELECT id, name, target_industries, target_size_bands, target_role_seniorities, target_business_models, weight FROM public.icp_profiles WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY weight DESC) t;

INSERT INTO public.contacts_enriched (email, name, company_input, role_input, source, company_name, industry, size_band, hq_country, business_model, signals, role_seniority, role_function, outreach_hook, outreach_confidence, confidence_notes, icp_id, icp_name, icp_score, band) VALUES (NULLIF('{{ ($json.email || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), NULLIF('{{ ($json.name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), NULLIF('{{ ($json.company_input || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), NULLIF('{{ ($json.role_input || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), NULLIF('{{ ($json.source || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), NULLIF('{{ ($json.enrichment.company.name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), '{{ ($json.enrichment.company.industry || 'Unknown').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.enrichment.company.size_band || 'unknown').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NULLIF('{{ ($json.enrichment.company.hq_country || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), '{{ ($json.enrichment.company.business_model || 'Unknown').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.enrichment.company.signals || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb, '{{ ($json.enrichment.contact.role_seniority || 'unknown').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.enrichment.contact.role_function || 'unknown').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NULLIF('{{ ($json.enrichment.outreach.hook || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), '{{ ($json.enrichment.outreach.confidence || 'low').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NULLIF('{{ ($json.enrichment.confidence_notes || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), {{ $json.icp_match.icp_id === null ? 'NULL' : $json.icp_match.icp_id }}, '{{ ($json.icp_match.icp_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', {{ $json.score }}, '{{ $json.band }}') ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name, industry = EXCLUDED.industry, size_band = EXCLUDED.size_band, hq_country = EXCLUDED.hq_country, business_model = EXCLUDED.business_model, signals = EXCLUDED.signals, role_seniority = EXCLUDED.role_seniority, role_function = EXCLUDED.role_function, outreach_hook = EXCLUDED.outreach_hook, outreach_confidence = EXCLUDED.outreach_confidence, confidence_notes = EXCLUDED.confidence_notes, icp_id = EXCLUDED.icp_id, icp_name = EXCLUDED.icp_name, icp_score = EXCLUDED.icp_score, band = EXCLUDED.band, enriched_at = now() RETURNING id, email, icp_score, band;
